newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble falls on long-covering ahead of holidays.
newsitem.headline: Rouble falls on long-covering ahead of holidays.

text.p: The rouble eased in arbitrage trading on Wednesday due to position covering and lower demand ahead of Russia's May Day holidays, dealers said.
Markets are closed on May 1 and 2 for the May Day holidays
followed by Victory Day on May 9.
roubles/dollar Apr 30 midday Apr 30 early Apr 29 close

"The market has been in a short (dollar) position, with the central bank keeping steady its bid daily rates. The trend had to change one day and this allowed the market to start speculative buying," Bank Menatep dealer Mikhail Zaretsky said.
Dealers said the market was thinner ahead of holidays which could also bring more notable rate fluctuations.
